The deadline is 21 December. Marcus posted it in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since. I replied to Dana in a thread on her message with that date.

I first checked that Dana is a member of #north-team, then read only that channel. I didn't use `search_messages` and didn't look anywhere she can't see. A deadline is an operational date, not a money figure, so she can have it. Since Marcus's message is the only source I can see, I suggested she ask him if she needs it confirmed as final.

One thing to know: the summary I wrote for you last time was also posted in #north-team as its own message. It only repeats the 21 December date and says I took no other action, so no finance figures were exposed.
